#JTT
## Where are your Screenshots going?

Are you sick of taking a screenshot and hunting for it on your desktop while it mocks you from plain sight? I have a solution! 

You can actually change where your screenshots go, it’s just a matter of knowing how to do so.

1. Press “Shift + command + 5”
2. You’ll see your screen go dark and a bar show up at the bottom
3. Select “options” on the bar
4. At the very top of the pop-up you can select where your screenshots go
5. You can even create a new folder under “New Location”    
6. I’ve made a folder in my photos so i can find them easier, i’ve even put a shortcut on my taskbar to make them right there when i need them.

There you go! No more hunting on your desktop!![](data:image/png;base64,)
